title: Common
description: Shared definitions for all Worldbuilder contracts (ADR-0023). This file only holds $defs; it validates nothing on its own.

ulid.title: Ulid
ulid.description: A ULID: 26 Crockford base32 characters, upper case. Canonical ids are minted ULIDs or derived from the card URI (first 128 bits of SHA-256(uri), ADR-0023).

cardId.title: CardId
cardId.description: Canonical card id (ULID). Canonical objects always hold this id, never a store-local id.

wbUri.title: WbUri
wbUri.description: Reference to a card in its home store: wb:<storeInstanceId>/<externalId>, in canonical form only: the external id NFC-normalised, UTF-8, every unreserved character literal and every other byte %XX with upper-case hex (RFC 3986). A URI that differs from buildUri(storeInstanceId, externalId) is not a card URI (for example %2D for '-'). storeInstanceId is a random UUID, never a hostname, path or user name (ADR-0005, ADR-0023).

sourceRef.title: SourceRef
sourceRef.description: A card id or an absolute URI (for example a wb: URI or a web address). Used where provenance must be machine-resolvable, e.g. player fields (ADR-0009).

humanAuthor.title: HumanAuthor
humanAuthor.description: The local human user. Human-only operations record this value.

author.title: Author
author.description: human, agent:<name>, or unknown. unknown is valid only on legacy format-1 cards and on edges read from legacy links (ADR-0009, ADR-0023).

layer.title: Layer
layer.description: Epistemic kind of a card (ADR-0007). believed is never a layer; it is a private stance (ADR-0008).

edgeKind.title: EdgeKind
edgeKind.description: Directed edge kinds of card format v2 (ADR-0023).

collection.title: Collection
collection.description: Store collection a card lives in (ADR-0023).

cardClass.title: CardClass
cardClass.description: Sensitivity class; input to disclosure-gate rules (ADR-0023).

disclosureTarget.title: DisclosureTarget
disclosureTarget.description: Where content may go (ADR-0012). `share` is other people: another user, a peer-to-peer exchange or a platform export. Conclusions (user-originated cards, stance data, AI analysis) are never allowed for `share`; own experience only after the user released the card; external-source cards only after release, as content and provenance (ADR-0036).

packageTarget.title: PackageTarget
packageTarget.description: The targets a context package or a rule evaluation can be built for: the screen, models and demos. Never `share` (ADR-0036).

contentHash.title: ContentHash
contentHash.description: sha256:<lower-case hex> over the RFC 8785 (JCS) serialisation of the hashed card content (ADR-0034).

text.title: Text
text.description: Non-empty text that is not only whitespace.
